title: Annotatio III §.V: Implies Conversion — Transsubstantiation’s chick under the egg-shell, soon to be named
pass_a_gloss: Yet this very thing, since it could not be taken properly — the substance of bread remaining diverse in whole species from the substance of Christ’s body, and neither of the disparates, whole and residual, about to participate the specific nature and essence of the other — implicitly insinuated a Conversion of bread into Christ’s body, i.e. fostered Transsubstantiation’s chick covered by the egg’s shell as by its wrapper, soon, the shell broken, about to look upon the light and after an octave as it were also to be circumcised and marked with its proper name.
pass_b_english: Taken properly that cannot stand: bread’s substance remains wholly diverse in species from Christ’s body, and neither disparate shares the other’s specific essence.
So it implicitly fostered Conversion — Transsubstantiation’s chick under the egg-shell, soon to break into light and after an octave be named.
source_text: Hoc tamen ipsum, cum propriè accipi non posset, panis substantia, à substantia corporis Christi, totâ specie diversa remanente, nec uno disparatorum integro residuôque, alterius naturam essentiamque specificam participaturo, Conversionem panis in corpus Christi implicitè insinuabat, i. e. Transsubstantiationis pullum, ovi cortice, ceu involucro suo, obtectum, fovebat, mox fractô cortice lucem adspecturum postque octiduum quasi circumcidendum etiam, nomineque proprio insigniendum.
